axioms.name: linearity_entangles
axioms.type: ∀ (C1 C2 C3 : Prop), C1 ∧ C2 → C3 → False
axioms.note: physical content of the entangled-detector toy model (re-derived in scripts/column3/01_trilemma_core.py): completeness + linear evolution yields a detector superposition with two macroscopic readings, incompatible with a single outcome

axioms.name: detector_single_readings_empirical
axioms.note: empirical premise of C3: detectors show one result (Bell 1990, 'outcomes')

axioms.name: born_rule_empirical
axioms.note: empirical: outcome weights are squared amplitudes

axioms.name: grw_lambda_empirical
axioms.note: empirical parameter: GRW rate lambda = 10^-16 s^-1 per particle (Ghirardi-Rimini-Weber 1986)

axioms.name: door_realization_principle
axioms.note: philosophical: each 2-claim pair is realized by an interpretation family (Bohm 1952 / GRW 1986 / Everett 1957)

lemmas.name: trilemma_from_model
lemmas.type: ∀ (C1 C2 C3 : Prop), C1 ∧ C2 ∧ C3 → False
lemmas.proof: intro C1 C2 C3 h; exact linearity_entangles C1 C2 C3 ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩ h.2.2

lemmas.name: trilemma_logic
lemmas.proof: intro C1 C2 C3 h hc; exact h ⟨hc.1, hc.2.2⟩ hc.2.1

lemmas.name: pair_exclusion
lemmas.proof: intro C1 C2 C3 h hc12 hc3; exact h ⟨hc12.1, hc12.2, hc3⟩

lemmas.name: branch_weight_sum_general
lemmas.gap: requires a nonzero-powers lemma (2^n ≠ 0, Mathlib pow_ne_zero/field_simp) or a core-level induction on Nat.pow; target: derive the general total-weight identity checked concretely by scripts/column3/04_branch_counting.py

lemmas.name: product_state_minors
lemmas.type: ∀ (a b c d x y u v : ℚ), a = x * u → b = x * v → c = y * u → d = y * v → a * d = b * c
lemmas.gap: requires ring-style normalization (Mathlib ring) or a manual calc over mul_comm/mul_assoc/mul_left_comm; this is the symbolic form of the minor test in scripts/column3/01_trilemma_core.py

lemmas.name: everett_emergence_gap
lemmas.gap: DELIBERATE TARGET, EXPECTED UNPROVEN: recovering single outcomes (C3) from C1∧C2 alone (the Everett emergence-of-outcome step). Requires a decision-theoretic or self-locating argument (Deutsch-Wallace) that this framework does not contain; keeping it sorry is the formal record that the many-worlds door still owes an account of outcomes/probability
